sources.supports: Full methods for 49 of 55 trophies; the only source with methods for #44, #45 and #50; stated beliefs only for #49 and #51.

sources.name: OutputLag
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
sources.supports: Full methods for 23 trophies, one-line or group notes for 21 more, list rows for 6; explicitly unconfirmed for 5.

sources.name: KeenGamer
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap – All 55 Trophies
sources.supports: Full methods for 6 trophies, one-line table rows for 44 more, the most detailed 100%-checklist threshold tables anywhere; explicitly unconfirmed for 5.

sources.name: eGamers
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies And Achievements, Plus The Hardest Ones
sources.supports: No original methods: every method tip is explicitly attributed to GTABase or PowerPyx (second-hand). 32 one-line requirement notes are its own; 5 trophies listed unconfirmed.

sources.name: GTABase
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: Full methods for 50 of 55 trophies, with per-trophy Gamerscore; hint-only or unconfirmed for 5.

sources.name: Exophase
sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
sources.supports: List-only for all 55. Deliberately not used for claims: its day-one rarity is internally inconsistent (Just Like Paradise 99.99% next to Paradise Lost 0.73% — everyone finishing Chapter 1 must hold the opening-mission trophy).

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
sources.supports: List-only for all 55, plus real progress counters on 20 trophies (0/100, 0/250, 0/9, 0/42, 0/14, 0/20, 0/8, 0/18, 0/3, 0/100, 0/50, 0/100, 0/5, 0/52, 0/9, 0/500, 0/250000, 0/100000, 0/8, 0/10). Cited only where a counter is genuinely used; no methods anywhere on the site.

sources.name: GTA Zone
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
sources.supports: Full methods for 21 trophies, one-line notes for 29 more; explicitly unconfirmed for 5. An explicit synthesis of PowerPyx and GTABase, not an independent guide.

stages.title: GOAL — 100% AND THE PLATINUM
stages.intro: Start here — the platinum is the last trophy you earn, and A Long Road is the longest job on the list.

stages.title: OPENING & CHAPTER 1
stages.intro: Start here — the one missable trophy lives in this chapter. Do Lucia's balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.

stages.title: CHAPTERS 2–3
stages.intro: The map widens, duo play opens, and the side questlines start marking themselves.

stages.title: CHAPTER 4 & THE FINALE
stages.intro: Bank vaults, the last story missions, and the final mission.

stages.title: SIDE CONTENT & LONG GRINDS
stages.intro: Stranger strands, hunting, cards, WAiNK scans, and maxing Strength — all still open after the story.

stages.title: ACTIVITIES & THE MAP
stages.intro: Stunts, ranges, races, challenges, vehicles, and unfogging all of Leonida.

stages.title: FREE-ROAM FEATS & MYSTERIES
stages.intro: One-off stunts and the five vague hidden trophies — two of them still have no confirmed method anywhere.

stages.title: MONEY & CLEANUP
stages.intro: The last robberies, the last dollars, the last garages — then the platinum pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.short: The platinum. It pops by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are done — about 200 hours of play, all of it offline.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies first — the platinum pops on its own the moment the last one lands, in single-player only, with no DLC needed.
Plan around the long tail: roughly 200 hours in total, about 60–80 on the story, about 100 on the 100% checklist, and about 10 on cleanup.
There is no online trophy and no difficulty setting, so one playthrough with free-roam after the story is enough.

disagreements.title: Platinum time: ~200 hours vs 300+ hours
disagreements.a: About 200 hours: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, OutputLag, eGamers and GTA Zone all land near 200 hours.
disagreements.b: Up to 300 hours or more, per Push Square (bonus source, not in the numbered list). All figures are launch-week estimates, not measured averages — no player could have finished a 200-hour checklist in the first days.

disagreements.title: Cheat block scope: disables trophies + saving vs session-only block
disagreements.a: Cheats disable trophies and saving the game (PowerPyx, OutputLag, GTA Zone).
disagreements.b: GTABase says the block is temporary, for the current game session only — the way it worked in GTA 5 and RDR2. GTA Zone itself notes GTABase's session view.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.short: The first story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — automatic, unmissable.

steps.text: Play the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — the trophy is automatic and cannot be missed.
It pops as the mission ends, so there is nothing to prepare and no way to lock yourself out.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 1. It pops as Chapter 2 begins — automatic, unmissable.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1 by playing through to the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? — the trophy pops as the new chapter starts.
Story trophies are automatic; keep playing and it lands on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 2. It pops as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City — automatic, unmissable.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2; the trophy pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
Automatic and unmissable — no side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4 — automatic, unmissable.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Automatic story trophy — just keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 4. PowerPyx says it pops after the final mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero — the chapter number itself is disputed.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 4; PowerPyx says it pops after the final main mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero.
Automatic and unmissable — the chapter trophy needs no extra step.

disagreements.title: Final mission chapter: Chapter 4 vs Chapter 5 (and PowerPyx vs itself)
disagreements.a: The finale sits in Chapter 4: PowerPyx says the final mission is Starting From Zero in Chapter 4, and gives that same mission for both #6 and #7.
disagreements.b: GTABase places Operation Savage Glory (#13) in Chapter 5, GTA Zone likewise lists Snow Storm as a Chapter 5 mission, and eGamers notes Beebom and CULTR word the final mission as Chapter 5.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.short: Finish the final story mission. PowerPyx names it Starting From Zero; the chapter number is disputed between sources.

steps.text: Play the final story mission to the end — PowerPyx names it Starting From Zero.
Free-roam carries on afterwards, and no trophy depends on how you play a mission.

disagreements.title: Final mission chapter: Chapter 4 vs Chapter 5 (and PowerPyx vs itself)
disagreements.a: The finale sits in Chapter 4: PowerPyx says the final mission is Starting From Zero in Chapter 4, and gives that same mission for both #6 and #7.
disagreements.b: GTABase places Operation Savage Glory (#13) in Chapter 5, GTA Zone likewise lists Snow Storm as a Chapter 5 mission, and eGamers notes Beebom and CULTR word the final mission as Chapter 5.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run — it pops during the mission. Automatic, unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run — the trophy pops during it.
Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist — it pops during the mission. Automatic, unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist — it pops during it.
Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play — it pops during the mission. Automatic, unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play — it pops during it.
Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners — it pops during the mission. Automatic, unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners — it pops during it.
Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown — it pops during the mission. Automatic, unmissable.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown — it pops during it.
Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.short: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory — GTABase places it in Chapter 5. Automatic, unmissable.

steps.text: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory — GTABase places it in Chapter 5.
Automatic and unmissable.

disagreements.title: Final mission chapter: Chapter 4 vs Chapter 5 (and PowerPyx vs itself)
disagreements.a: PowerPyx says the final mission is Starting From Zero in Chapter 4, and gives that same mission for both #6 and #7.
disagreements.b: GTABase places Operation Savage Glory (this trophy) in Chapter 5, GTA Zone likewise lists Snow Storm as a Chapter 5 mission, and eGamers notes Beebom and CULTR word the final mission as Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.short: The hardest trophy: reach 100% completion. The thresholds are lenient — about 60% true completion — and nothing on the list is missable.

steps.text: Open the checklist after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — work done during the story already counts.
Clear any 100 optional missions; there are far more than 100, so do them as they appear.
Scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with WAiNK and study 100 of the 255 animals with binoculars.
Finish 70 of the 80 challenges and 300 of the 397 stunts.
Complete the all-or-nothing rows in full: all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races, and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
Meditate at 15 of the 18 spots, scan 100 WAiNK locations, and finish 15 of the 18 card sets.
Remember the thresholds are lenient — about 60% true completion — and nothing on the list is missable.

disagreements.title: "Robberies in full" for 100%: everything vs partial counts
disagreements.a: PowerPyx and GTABase: the only tasks that require everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, and Bret's quests — all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations included.
disagreements.b: KeenGamer's 100% table gives partial counts inside robbery types: Smash 'N' Grabs 34 of 35 and Stick Ups 50 of 91. KeenGamer agrees with version A on bank vaults 8/8 and gang operations 39/39 — the tension may be definitional, not a direct contradiction.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.short: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. Flying under bridges is quickest — and 100% needs 300, so keep going.

steps.text: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, in any mix of the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Flying under bridges is the quickest kind — pick those first.
Track progress per region under Progress > Activities > Stunts and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Keep going to 300 afterwards — the 100% checklist needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.short: Try all 9 activity types once — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race win, and a stunt.

steps.text: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, winning a race, and a stunt.
Check what is left under Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find each type.
Most come automatically while doing other trophies, so this usually pops on its own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.short: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Every source agrees on 42 medals — they disagree on whether there are 12 ranges or 2.

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
There are 12 ranges holding the 42 golds between them.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger (#36).
Aim for gold on every challenge — the medal count is agreed at 42 even though sources differ on the range count.

disagreements.title: Shooting range locations: 12 ranges vs 2 ranges
disagreements.a: 12 ranges: GTABase and GTA Zone both say 42 golds across 12 ranges, and PowerPyx links a guide titled All 12 Shooting Range Locations & 42 Gold Medals.
disagreements.b: 2 ranges: OutputLag hedges that there should be two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them, and Push Square (bonus source) names both — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn, and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.short: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough here — 100% wants all 42 races.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough here.
The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races across those 14 spots, so keep racing past this trophy.
PowerPyx counts 42 races across 14 drone race locations.
Find the spots on the map and work through them in free-roam.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.short: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Winning the same race twice does not count.

steps.text: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available.
Winning the same race again does not count — each win must be a new race.
Mix race types freely; any 20 count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.short: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui he texts you a marked fishing spot — follow his questline.

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you have met Cal, watch for his text marking a fishing location with a purple map icon.
Follow his fishing questline to unlock his challenge.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge itself.
If the challenge is not offered yet, work through Cal's earlier fishing quests first — the challenge unlocks through his questline.

notes.text: Push Square alone adds that Cal asks for a Parrotfish over 2kg, fished from a boat with a rod. Single-source tip — no other guide read gives the fish species or weight.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.short: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games. Three are on the TV at home; the fourth is on arcade machines around Leonida.

steps.text: There are 4 arcade games (Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV at home via the controllers, from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines around Leonida.
To complete a game, finish all its levels at least once — beating every challenge is not needed.
Any one game counts; pick the one you find easiest.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.short: Finish Andy's five-quest storyline. Lucia-only, starts in Chapter 3 in Belville — still open after the story.

steps.text: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when he calls and then texts her an address in Belville.
Work through the five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass.
The last quest, Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse), awards the trophy.
All quests stay available after the story.
Watch for the questline to be marked automatically in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.short: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving storyline: recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. He goes quiet after Chapter 1, then comes back.

steps.text: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 — after the mission Island Dreams he calls, then is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive at the purple treasure-chest markers and use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor; bring it back to Kenton.
There are 7 shipwrecks in total; after the first set he calls you back and marks more locations.
Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures — he is briefly unavailable after Chapter 1, then returns.

notes.text: Push Square alone names Kenton's final mission 'Maritime Disputes'.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.short: Finish Billy's five jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Billy's questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Work through the five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes.
The last job, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy.
All five stay available after the story.
The jobs are marked automatically once the questline opens.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.short: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands — but only some questlines count. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Andy, Billy, Tyrone and the rest do not.

steps.text: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands — only some questlines count.
Confirmed counting strands: Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and deliveries).
These do NOT count: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, and Eddie — they have their own trophies or are not strangers.
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears — OutputLag alone flags it as time-sensitive (hourglass icon).
Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish; all strands stay available after the story.

notes.text: eGamers alone warns that stranger mission chains have windows tied to story progress, attributing the claim to TechWiser — but the TechWiser article actually read contains no such claim, so this is unverified at origin and shown only as one outlet's warning.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.short: Deliver all 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List to his garage in west Vice City. The list opens after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.

steps.text: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also unlocks the Key Cloner.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); the first, the Granforma Zorrusso, is delivered in the story mission itself.
Scan cars with WAiNK to see if they are on the list, and look around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotel driveways — cars in better condition pay more.
Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.short: Finish Tyrone's storyline: destroy the synthetic labs around Vice City, then shut them down for good. Jason-only.

steps.text: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City (quest: Take Out Kitty Litter).
Once enough labs are gone, his last job, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), awards the trophy.
Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.short: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia. The first one — Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, Chapter 1 — vanishes after the chapter.

steps.text: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia — meditating together at a spot counts twice.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, and choose Accept.
That first meditation is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save.
The last meditation needs both characters playable together, possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
For the 100% checklist only 15 of the 18 are needed — the trophy itself needs 18.

disagreements.title: Missables: one possibly missable vs none known
disagreements.a: Possibly 1 missable: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, OutputLag, GTA Zone and eGamers all flag this trophy — the Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after the chapter.
disagreements.b: No known missables: Push Square's full trophy guide contains no missable warning anywhere and never mentions the Chapter 1 meditation at all. It never says 'no missables' in so many words — it is silent on the question.

disagreements.title: Duo-play unlock point: after Breakfast Run vs after Coffee Break
disagreements.a: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2: PowerPyx and GTABase both put duo play — and the last meditation — after Coffee Break.
disagreements.b: After Breakfast Run in Chapter 2: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run.

trophies.resolvedNote: RESOLVED — not a live conflict: 18 for the trophy, 15 for the 100% list. PSNProfiles' 0/18 counter settles it for the trophy itself. eGamers' comparison table frames 18 vs 15 as a disagreement between sources, but the two numbers measure two different things.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.short: Hunt for Bret Vogel. His questline is Jason-only and starts after Coffee Break — which animal exactly triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed.

steps.text: Bret's hunting questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — he texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back to Bret as Jason.
A clean one-shot kill keeps the carcass pristine and pays more, but is not required.
Which animal exactly unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed — the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.short: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets out of the 18. The Collections menu shows how close each set is.

steps.text: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets out of the 18.
You do not need all of them — the Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past this trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.short: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app — any 100 count, across Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures and No Flusher tags.

steps.text: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1) — any 100 count.
The spots split into 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, and No Flusher tags.
There are more than 100 in the world, so pick the ones nearest your route.
The 100% checklist needs the same 100 scans, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.short: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Most finish on their own while you play — 100% needs 70, so this comes along the way.

steps.text: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
View and track them under Progress > Challenges — finished ones show a Completed checkmark.
Many complete naturally while working on other trophies, so leave the grind until late and pick the easiest remaining ones.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so this unlocks along the way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.short: With your partner beside you, hit 4 stars and escape — it only pops once you are out of the red heat zone.

steps.text: Only possible once Jason and Lucia are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2) — call your partner by holding Right, then Triangle.
Get a 4-star wanted level, then escape — the trophy pops only once you are out of the red heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area.
Easiest escape: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
It also pops during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… and during bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

disagreements.title: Duo-play unlock point: after Breakfast Run vs after Coffee Break
disagreements.a: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2: PowerPyx and GTABase both put duo play after Coffee Break.
disagreements.b: After Breakfast Run in Chapter 2: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.short: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while still wanted. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together.

steps.text: Only after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 — call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), then rob 3 shops in a row while still wanted.
Stay in the flashing red/blue wanted level the whole time — if the stars fade to only the red heat zone, the chain breaks.
Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3; go in with body armor, sticky bombs, and healing items.
The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — wait before hitting a fourth; if it still has not popped, rob a fourth.

disagreements.title: Duo-play unlock point: after Breakfast Run vs after Coffee Break
disagreements.a: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2: PowerPyx and GTABase both put duo play after Coffee Break.
disagreements.b: After Breakfast Run in Chapter 2: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.short: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK. You do not need to drive them — stand by a busy road and scan traffic.

steps.text: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — you do not need to drive them.
Stand at a busy road and scan passing traffic; scanning is enough.
Check discovered vehicles under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
The 100% checklist needs 200 base-model vehicles, so this comes automatically.

notes.text: Push Square alone adds that getting inside a vehicle also discovers it, not only scanning. Compatible with the guides, not contradictory.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.short: Take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. Fill Focus first, use an assault rifle, and pick gang thugs — cops and civilians do not count.

steps.text: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm — it slows time and drains the purple focus bar.
Fill Focus first (eat, drink, or wash up at home; Adrenaline extends Focus) and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556.
Take down 5 enemies in a single use — gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers, and civilians do not seem to count.
It gets easier as Focus levels up (4 levels) — raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.short: Steal a passenger jet docked at a VCIA boarding bridge — gates E3/E4 are easiest — take off, and fly about 1 km away.

steps.text: At VCIA, steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal's boarding bridge — planes parked on the airfield do not count.
Easiest: the plane at gates E3/E4 — drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit.
Drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off, and fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away — the pop is delayed until you are that far out.
Save first — the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.short: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far south-west of the map, and take out enemies from inside it.

steps.text: Find the military tanks at Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far south-west of the map — they stand at the south end of the base.
Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance.
Get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
Save first — the base is guarded.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.short: Rob a jewelry store unseen. Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun for the locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm.

steps.text: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies.
Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, destroy the security footage, and disable the alarm — then leave without being seen.
Good target: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City; the trophy pops shortly after leaving.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.short: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — bring your partner, the haul is too heavy alone.

steps.text: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces bank vault robberies.
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then go in quickly while the guard has the vault open.
You cannot carry all the cash alone — bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag.
Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles.
Only any 5 of the 8 vaults are needed here (all 8 for 100%); each pays up to $205,000, and Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

disagreements.title: Maximum Withdrawal grade: Silver vs Bronze
disagreements.a: Silver, 40G: the official list, GTABase, OutputLag, KeenGamer, eGamers, GTA Zone, PSNProfiles and PlanetGTA6 all agree on Silver.
disagreements.b: Bronze: Push Square alone lists Maximum Withdrawal as Bronze in its trophy guide — the only grade dissent found in any source read. The displayed grade is Silver, per the official list.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.short: Rob an armored truck and escape. A bank vault job counts — or box in a truck, sticky-bomb its back doors, and get away.

steps.text: Robbing a bank vault (see #40) counts as robbing an armored truck — tail the truck to the bank and get into the vault while it is open.
Before vaults unlock, box in an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, and blow it open.
The trophy pops only after escaping the red heat zone — or use a Pay 'n' Spray.
All 8 Large Bank Jobs are needed for 100%, so this comes automatically.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.short: Unfog the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas. Fastest by plane, flying over every dark patch.

steps.text: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas.
Fastest by plane: fly over every dark patch until the entire map is visible.
The map unfogs as you travel, so this finishes naturally while doing everything else.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.short: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. 100% needs all 39 operations, so this pops on the way.

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs — operations show as yellow icons when you go near them.
Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.
Only 1 per gang is needed here, but 100% needs all 39, so this pops on the way.
Many operations are marked automatically from story progress.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.short: Drink an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar. Single-source method — PowerPyx is the only guide with steps; five others still list it unconfirmed.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar.
Buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it while standing next to the bar.
Five other guides still list this trophy as unconfirmed — this is a single-source method (PowerPyx only), shown as such.

disagreements.title: Method known vs unconfirmed (plus stale second-hand claims)
disagreements.a: A specific method is known: PowerPyx says go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar.
disagreements.b: Exact steps unconfirmed: OutputLag, KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA Zone and eGamers all list the trigger as unconfirmed. eGamers and GTA Zone also claim PowerPyx marks it unknown — that was true of an earlier PowerPyx version and is stale against the page read on 20 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.short: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it through the window. Single-source method — PowerPyx only.

steps.text: First get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City — only this car works.
Drive it forward straight through the showroom window.
The pop is slightly delayed and comes after you drive further away on the street — a single-source method (PowerPyx only).

disagreements.title: Method known vs unconfirmed (plus stale second-hand claims)
disagreements.a: A specific method is known: PowerPyx says steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City (needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3) and drive it through the showroom window.
disagreements.b: Exact steps unconfirmed: OutputLag, KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA Zone and eGamers all list the trigger as unconfirmed. eGamers and GTA Zone also claim PowerPyx marks it unknown — that was true of an earlier PowerPyx version and is stale against the page read on 20 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

counter.label: key valuables stolen at Kingpin Bowling

trophies.short: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: take all 3 key valuables, then escape the police. Bring sticky bombs for the safe.

steps.text: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation, first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — they are needed to blow open the safe.
Take all 3 key valuables: the Luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway.
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item — and you do not need all three in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.short: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train together — working out with one trains the other too.

steps.text: Only after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch between both characters.
Raise Strength to maximum for both Jason and Lucia — check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength.
Buy a gym membership and always train together — while you work out with one character, the other trains automatically, so you make double progress.
Filter the map for fitness clubs (dumbbell icon); after the story you can also train at home.

disagreements.title: Duo-play unlock point: after Breakfast Run vs after Coffee Break
disagreements.a: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2: PowerPyx and GTABase both put duo play after Coffee Break.
disagreements.b: After Breakfast Run in Chapter 2: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.short: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It fills up on its own across robberies and fights — do not push toward Irredeemable, it is permanent.

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — robberies and enemy encounters all count.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to watch the count — the trophy list itself shows the running total.
It usually comes naturally while working on all other trophies; do not push toward the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent.
If it is still missing at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

notes.text: The 500 figure traces to GTABase as a single origin — but PSNProfiles' 0/500 counter confirms the number independently from platform data.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.short: Not pinned down yet. No source has a method — the only lead anywhere is PowerPyx's stated belief that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

steps.text: No source has a method for this trophy — PowerPyx's only lead is a stated belief that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, not a confirmed step.
Treat it as not pinned down yet: keep playing, watch for updates, and do not grind anything for it on this lead alone.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.short: Complete the UFO Easter Egg: north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, alone. Single-source method — PowerPyx only.

steps.text: Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, alone.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back; the spawn is slightly random.
Follow the path into the woods next to the car to find the UFO (bright blue light in the sky), approach it, and talk to the woman it drops.
Offer to help her and go back to her car at the roadside — a single-source method (PowerPyx only).

disagreements.title: Method known vs unconfirmed (plus stale second-hand claims)
disagreements.a: A specific method is known: PowerPyx says complete the UFO Easter Egg at the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, solo — find the blinking car, follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, and help the woman it drops back to her car.
disagreements.b: Exact steps unconfirmed: OutputLag, KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA Zone and eGamers all list the trigger as unconfirmed. eGamers and GTA Zone also claim PowerPyx marks it unknown — that was true of an earlier PowerPyx version and is stale against the page read on 20 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.short: Not pinned down yet. No source has a method — the only lead anywhere is PowerPyx's stated belief about kicking enemies from a motorcycle.

steps.text: No source has a method for this trophy — PowerPyx's only lead is a stated belief that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, not a confirmed step.
Treat it as not pinned down yet: the description points to a melee drive-by, but the exact trigger is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.short: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills through fences. Yasmani in Vice City pays the most — it builds up during the 100% robberies.

steps.text: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Deliver a total of $250,000 in marked bills — it counts across all robberies, no need to bring it at once.
Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.short: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest.

steps.text: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops — it is a running total.
Guns, car mods, and tattoos are the fastest way through it — they are the most expensive.
Shop counts: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear Stores, 18 Hair & Beauty Salons, 11 Tattoo Studios, 15 Electronics Stores.
It builds up naturally while buying gear for other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.short: Buy the 8 purchasable garages in the Vice City Real Estate app — about $160,000 total. The 4 story garages do not count.

steps.text: Buy the 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate phone app — about $160,000 in total.
The app unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses).
The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.
Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially in Chapters 3–4.

notes.text: Push Square alone names all 8 garages with prices summing to exactly $160,000: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Each has 1 parking spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.short: Register 10 stolen vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Buy garages first — each registration needs a free parking spot.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray, then Register.
At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
You need free garage space first (see #54), and each registration costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes.

notes.text: Push Square presents Pay 'n' Spray / Mod Shop registration as the general method, without the Moses/trackers staging — compatible if read as the later-game method.
